title: English Practice Quiz 0963
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A colleague asks for help. A polite reply is:
questions.explanation: Certainly. What do you need? is helpful and polite.

questions.question: You need to report a problem. You say:
options: There is an issue with the printer.
questions.explanation: There is an issue with... clearly introduces a problem.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: ___ going to arrive soon.
questions.explanation: They're is the contraction of they are.

questions.question: She is the ___ student in the class.
questions.explanation: Use the superlative tallest when comparing one with the whole class.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: After doesn't, use the base form of the verb: like.

questions.question: I ___ him last week.
questions.explanation: Use the past simple with a finished past time such as last week.

questions.question: I saw ___ elephant at the zoo.
questions.explanation: Use an before a vowel sound.

questions.question: You look tired. You ___ get some rest.
